The Chair of Numerical Modeling and Simulation at EPFL is hiring a postdoc to start a new research line combining proof assistants, AI, and numerical analysis for PDEs.

Possible directions: formalizing stability and error estimates for finite element methods in Lean, or AI-assisted discovery of new discretization paradigms, with their properties verified formally.

Profile: PhD in mathematics, computer science, or related; strong background in formal verification with Lean; experience with AI-assisted theorem proving; working knowledge of numerical methods for PDEs.

1-year contract, renewable. Starting as soon as possible. Applications reviewed until filled.
